title: Using the information the game gives you
target: How to read what TCG Card Shop Simulator is telling you about customers and prices, instead of changing things at random when takings drop.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A moment to look rather than react

steps.do: Read what a review is about rather than guessing why people are unhappy.
steps.because: the game keeps a list of what a review can be about (ECustomerReviewType)

steps.do: Watch what a customer is doing, not only where they are standing.
steps.because: each customer is in a named state of its own (ECustomerState)

steps.do: Check the price a customer would see rather than trusting memory.
steps.because: prices are shown on tags and a board of their own (InteractablePriceTag)

steps.do: Use the price-check screen instead of guessing at the counter.
steps.because: the game has a screen for checking a price (CheckPriceScreen)

steps.do: Search your cards when you are looking for something specific.
steps.because: there is a search screen for choosing a card (PlayCardSetUIScreen_SearchCardSelection)

commonMistakes: Ignoring the review types and changing the wrong thing.
Assuming customers are doing what it looks like they are doing.
Pricing from memory rather than from the screen.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
